adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the feed is fetched with `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and no explicit timeout/size limit is set in this diff. The job then iterates `rss.items.each` and calls `TopicEmbed.import` for each item every poll; although `TopicEmbed.import` avoids recreating unchanged posts via `content_sha1`/DB lookup, it still performs per-item SHA1 computation and DB queries each run. A `feed_key` method is defined but never used, and there is no Last-Modified/ETag conditional fetch logic shown. This is a concrete robustness/performance concern grounded in the diff, but not a directly verifiable functional break.
